about: Craft checklist, department voice (P3b, docs/CRAFT_CURRICULUM.md). Same shape as training/video_criteria.json, plus artefact (the field the check reads), source (docs/research/CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10.md section and verdict, the repository rule, or 'Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified)') and enforced_by (an existing path, a planned validator with its phase in planned, or manual). check = code (a validator measures it), critic (the script-critic or editorial review ticks it), eye (the creator's or Claude's look at the frames), manual (a person does it). Every number is a BP id in sourced_rules.json; nothing here is binding: no row has two verified source types yet. Skill: .claude/skills/elevenlabs-voice/SKILL.md.

criteria.name: the heard pace sits in BP-01's band
criteria.source: repo: BP-01 (the Blueprint's 135-145 wpm is conflict 2; Rodero 2020 found 180 best)

criteria.name: every candidate voice has a measured profile from one test read
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): the profile metrics; no opened source (CRAFT_SOURCES §12)

criteria.name: two cast voices differ by at least one measured margin
the creator picks the voice by ear from the top three
one stressed word per sentence; a tag only where the delivery changes
no pause before a punch line; held pauses inside their limit
chunk size, carried context, pauses by tags and punctuation
a new take matches the voice's baseline (no drift)
criteria.artefact: take vs the channel voice baseline
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): drift metric planned as EL-13 (CRAFT_SOURCES §12)

criteria.name: an animated shot's line carries delivery (pace, loudness, colour) and a face the lens sees
